name: cat pose
description: Round your spine upward from hands and knees to stretch the back. A gentle way to loosen the spine and wake up the core.
instructions: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.
